_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: In the beginning, darkness over the water.
God said, Let there be light.
Through the sea, through the fire, God led them home.
The Lord has done great things.
Breath came into dry bones, and the dead stood up.
The grave could not hold them.
Now the stone is rolled away.
Christ is risen. Come, let us worship. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: We have come while it is still dark, with one small flame between us — the way God's first word split the night and called up the light.
Christ is our light.
This is the fire that went before them in the wilderness, the dawn that found the sea rolled back and the people walking through on dry ground.
Christ is our light.
This is the breath that swept across the valley of bones, until the dry and the dead stood up and lived.
Christ is our light.
And this is the morning the women found the tomb thrown open and empty. Lift the flame higher, friends; the night is over.
Christ is our light. Christ is risen, alleluia!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: We come while it is dark, one flame between us.
Christ is our light.
God split the night and called up the dawn.
Christ is our light.
The sea opened, the dry bones stood, the tomb is empty.
Christ is our light.
Lift the flame higher; the night is over.
Christ is our light. Christ is risen!
